name: kid-games
description: Kid Games: Mighty Mower, Coaster Doodle, Monster Truck, Gadget Glam, Turbo Quest and Critter Clinic in one iPad app. No ads, no sign-up, no internet.

scripts.test: for g in games/*/; do echo "== $g"; (cd "$g" && npm test --silent) || exit 1; done
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd www && python3 -m http.server 8080
